span.p:
On entry
• set the mix valve to 20 %
• stop the pump
• stop warm-up mixing control
On exit
• start the pump
• hold the return at warmup_temperature with the mix valve

On entry
• run the pump at the group's minimum duty point

On entry
• hold the return at recovery_temperature with the pump
On exit
• disable pump flow control
